CustomField.description: Users are approved with the PeopleSoft role SR Standard Student Pages View This role provides faculty and staff with view access to student information. This information includes name and address data in Campus Community, student records data in the Student Services Center, the ability to print an unofficial transcript and the ability to view holds on the student's record. This is the basic, default role for access to student records. ASU_SA_SR Standard Stdnt Pages
